resources.string: Your LiteDash account lives in the LiteDash Connect app on your phone.
Your phone and your screen talk over Wi-Fi. Pick how:
Turn on the screen’s Wi-Fi and connect it to your phone’s hotspot.
Turn on the screen’s hotspot and connect your phone to it.
Install LiteDash Connect and create your account
Point the camera at this code
Your phone and the screen are talking
To see your music here, open LiteDash Connect and tap “Allow” under Link
The screen isn’t on any network with your phone
Open LiteDash Connect on your phone and connect it to this same network
Can’t hear it? Connect Bluetooth from the stereo
Bluetooth is connected for calls only, so it plays on your phone. Connect it from the stereo, or turn on “Media audio” for this stereo on your phone
We’ll know once your phone is connected and playing
To connect it again you\'ll have to scan the code again from LiteDash Connect.
While your phone is connected and plays music, the Music widget shows and controls it. When it leaves, it goes back to what you had.
